name: Nightcap Zirdel
bio: Zirdel and his bar – the Nightcap – have been famous throughout the Evernight underworld for decades, always ready to offer both a rave and a refuge to any who step through the door. Whether you need an attentive ear, a stiff drink, or a butt kicked: Nightcap Zirdel is your guy.
